general_ui_ux_guidelines: All interactive elements (buttons, nav pills, game cards, channel rows) MUST include exact data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='nav-scores', data-testid='game-card-0').
Maintain 10-ft TV viewing readability: text minimum 12sp (24px) for body, 18sp (36px) for team names, 28sp (56px) for scores.
Focus state contrast: Focused item must feature electric cyan border (#00F0FF), scale bump (1.05x), and glow ring to provide unmistakable feedback for D-pad control.
Zero transparent backgrounds on text surfaces or overlays: all dropdowns, cards, and modal dialogs must have solid tinted backings (min #0C1322) with backdrop-blur.

Hardware performance target: Keep canvas redraws light, use CSS GPU transforms (`transform: scale() translate3d()`), avoid heavy unthrottled DOM mutations for smooth rendering on low-end Android TV hardware.
instructions_to_main_agent: Implement Astra Sports Hub design blueprint under /app/frontend/public/sportshub-astra/ using pure HTML/CSS/JS or React, preserving all sample data from mock.js and providing seamless screen switching via URL parameter '?screen=' (scores, league, map, following, game-mlb, game-nfl, fields). Ensure focus states are hyper-visible and visual presentation reflects top 1% broadcast design.
